results.title: Blind Road
results.overview: Completed in 2019, this short film remained unreleased for years before finally premiering at various film festivals in 2025, where it screened to critical acclaim and won multiple awards. In 2026, it made its official broadcast debut on television and was released online for global audiences.  Driven by Dhaka's relentless traffic, a reckless motorcyclist dangerously rode onto a sidewalk, terrifying pedestrians and aggressively confronting a visually impaired man who was using the guided path. As an outraged crowd gathered to confront the illegal rider for his blatant disregard for safety and decency, the blind man remarkably stepped in to shield his aggressor. Ultimately, his unexpected act of grace transformed a moment of hostility into a powerful lesson in compassion.

results.title: Wrathbone
results.overview: International rock star Nigel Wrathbone had everything: money and fame, unbridled hedonism, creative freedom. Then he died and went to Hell.

results.title: Jack Johnson: SURFILMUSIC
results.overview: An intimate documentary following Johnson's journey from surfer to filmmaker to world-renowned musician through rare archives and present-day reflections on how experience, friendship, and exploration shaped his sound and stories.

results.title: Beautiful Girl
results.overview: "I'll be home soon," Cece said.  On a rainy cold evening, Mai, a Vietnamese grandmother with dementia, is left home alone.

results.title: Away with Words
results.overview: In this silent romantic comedy-drama, a reality-challenged title writer must navigate the perils and possibilities of two worlds: the one in his head, and the one in which he has a chance at real love.

results.title: EQUITY 6928
results.overview: At the dawn of cinema and the notion of a moving image, a fierce battle commenced between inventors Louis Le Prince and Thomas Edison to conceive and design a machine capable of projecting multiple frames a second, thus taming light and shadow. EQUITY 6928, slips back in time through the archives and spins a tale of intrigue, murderous intent and nefarious corporate interests.

results.title: Black Eyed Peas - Live at Brännbollsyran 2026
results.original_title: Black Eyed Peas - Live at Brännbollsyran 2026
results.overview: Black Eyed Peas perform live at Brännbollsyran in Umeå, Sweden, on June 7, 2026. Headlining the festival's Arena Stage, the group delivers an energetic concert featuring hits from throughout their career in front of a live festival audience.

results.title: George & Rosa
results.overview: George, an old man living alone on the margins, in a small desert town, meets Rosa, a woman in similar circumstances. Although they don’t speak the same language, George and Rosa form a bond. Together, they find companionship and something akin to love. But their relationship may not last, once George learns Rosa’s secret.

results.title: Noutro tempo
results.overview: Beto, a retired soccer player, returns to his city to start a routine job. He stays in a family apartment with his niece Elisa, focused on the preparation of some oppositions. Throughout a day, the story follows her wandering through the streets, in contrast to her daily routine. At the end and at the end of the day both share memories and silences.

results.title: Death Is Something That Happens to Others
results.original_title: La muerte es algo que les sucede a los demás
results.overview: Alberto, my grandfather, waits for the grim reaper. His friends have died and he hardly ever has visitors. After the unexpected death of his son Javier, my father, the family hides the news from him, until one day I decide to tell him. The project is based on intimate records of the three of them.

results.title: Mudharkanal
results.overview: A brilliant teenager destined for greatness loses everything to drug addiction after one wrong friendship. When he gets a final chance to rebuild his life, he must confront the consequences of his past before they consume his future.

results.title: Hey Balwanth
results.overview: Expecting to inherit the family business, a young man instead finds himself running a very different enterprise while juggling love, lies, and an unexpected legacy.

results.title: Death of a Parent
results.overview: A sadistic wellness influencer spirals at a trauma therapy retreat.

results.title: Discipline
results.overview: Kelly, a young teacher, starts working at a public school on the outskirts of Contagem. Idealistic, she tries to push for a change, but ends up going too far. During a lesson, she gets into an argument with Nicolas, a young student. The quarrel brings some learning: Kelly learns that, on the outskirts of Brazil, the exception is the rule; and Nicolas learns that only by tearing down the present can the future be seen.

results.title: Secrets on the Ranch
results.overview: After inheriting her late mother’s declining Montana ranch, recently divorced Romy Taylor uncovers the remains of her long missing sister in the backyard while digging a garden.

results.title: Birth Is for P*ssies
results.overview: A rookie doula is thrust into her first birth with a mother she's never met. After a rocky start, she quickly learns supporting women through labor is messier, funnier, and more profound than any training could have prepared her for.

results.title: Um Dia Extraordinário
results.overview: A small-scale farmer, the only daughter caring for her aging mother and the family land, has her quiet life upended when a mysterious crop circle appears in her field. The phenomenon brings her estranged sister and brother back into her world, forcing them to confront the emotional distance that has grown between them.

results.title: Les métamorphoses, au féminin
results.overview: A schoolteacher reads aloud excerpts from the most poignant scene of violence against women in Ovid's Metamorphoses. As the ancient verses echo through the classroom, her students begin to recognize beneath the poetry  - the myths reveal themselves to be an unsettling mirror of contemporary reality.
